2607.22231.title: TRaM-VSR: Importance-Aware Token Routing and Merging for One-Step Diffusion Video Super-Resolution
2607.22231.paper_summary: Video super-resolution (VSR) using large-scale Diffusion Transformer (DiT) priors achieves exceptional perceptual quality but is often impractical due to the quadratic computational cost of processing dense spatio-temporal token sequences. Existing efficiency-oriented methods risk irreversible detail loss and temporal flickering, a vulnerability especially pronounced in one-step diffusion models. To address this, we propose TRaM-VSR, a Token Routing and Merging framework for adaptive token allocation, leveraging both context-aware video priors and network-level priors. First, token importance is estimated by fusing motion-sensitive temporal cues with semantic text similarity, isolating dynamic objects and structural boundaries. Next, this importance is further calibrated and adjusted by an offline planner to guide routing across optimally grouped network blocks. Technically, within each routed group, structurally critical tokens are processed in a high-fidelity local stream, while less informative tokens are aggregated into a compact global stream, both modulated by network depth and aligned with the multigranular nature of diffusion models. Extensive experiments show that TRaM-VSR accelerates inference significantly while preserving state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and robust temporal consistency. The code is available at https://github.com/Ree1s/TRaM-VSR.
2607.22231.paper_summary_zh: 視頻超解析（VSR）使用大規模擴散Transformer（DiT）先驗達到卓越的感知質量，但由於處理密集時空標記序列的二次計算成本，往往不切實際。現有的效率導向方法存在不可逆的細節損失和時間閃爍的風險，這種脆弱性在一步擴散模型中特別明顯。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了TRaM-VSR，一個用於自適應標記分配的標記路由和合併框架，利用上下文感知的視頻先驗和網絡級先驗。首先，通過融合運動敏感的時間線索和語義文本相似性來估計標記的重要性，從而孤立動態物體和結構邊界。接下來，這一重要性通過離線規劃器進一步校準和調整，以引導路由跨越最佳分組的網絡塊。在技術上，在每個路由組內，結構上關鍵的標記在高保真本地流中處理，而信息量較少的標記則聚合到緊湊的全局流中，兩者都受到網絡深度的調節並與擴散模型的多粒度性對齊。廣泛的實驗表明，TRaM-VSR顯著加速了推理，同時保持了最先進的重建質量和穩健的時間一致性。代碼可在 https://github.com/Ree1s/TRaM-VSR 獲得。
